pleaseTryAgainInAMoment: Please try again in a moment.
sharingIsnTAvailableOnThis: Sharing isn't available on this device, but the receipt PDF was generated.

thisTicketCouldNotBeFound: This ticket could not be found.
onlyAcceptSent: Only accept tickets sent to your Abonten account. A PDF, screenshot or forwarded email may have been sold to several people.
acceptedToast: The ticket is yours now, with a new code.
couldNotAnswer: We couldn't answer that offer. Try again.
couldNotSend: We couldn't send the ticket. Try again.
ticketSentToast: Ticket sent. It stays yours until it's accepted.
sendTicketTitle: Send this ticket to a friend
sendTicketBody: Your ticket for {title} moves to their account when they accept it, with a new code. Your copy then stops working.
sendToPhoneHint: If this number has no Abonten account yet, we'll text it a link. They sign up with the number to accept.
staysYoursUntilAccepted: It stays yours until it's accepted, and you can take it back until then. An offer nobody accepts comes back to you.
acceptByThem: It comes back to you if it isn't accepted by {date}.
notTextedHint: We couldn't text this number. Tell them to sign up on Abonten with it to accept the ticket.
sendBlockedOrganizerOff: The organizer has turned off sending tickets for this event.
sendBlockedTooManyMoves: This ticket has already been sent the most times allowed.
sendBlockedRestricted: Your account can't send tickets right now.
refundGoesToPayer: This ticket was sent to you, so any refund goes to the person who paid for it.
sentToYouNoRefund: This ticket was sent to you, so its refund belongs to the person who paid. If you can't go, send it back to them.
keepCodePrivate: Keep your code private. Anyone who has it could try to use your ticket.
organizerCouldNotSave: We couldn't save that. Try again.
organizerCardTitle: Guests can send tickets to friends
organizerCardBody: A guest who can't come, or who bought for a group, can send a ticket to someone's Abonten account. It gets a new code when it's accepted, so the old one stops working. Turn it off if guests must be named in advance.
organizerOffClosesOffers: Turning it off also closes offers still waiting to be accepted. Those tickets stay with the guests who hold them.
